x: Drake has certainly improved in winning this very close handicap The "Footer" school had a good day, as R. Freestone took the Novice's Prize, and H.
Hickey and R. Freestone, who all ran extremely well, and should, if they persevere, improve on their performances.
Ellison was appealed to by phone on Wednesday and replied with a cheery "I'll be there, boy." He was; and thanks to the skilful driving of Reg.
We gained our usual easy win in the team race, placing our fourteen men in the first 25 positions. Our handicap, in conjunction, was won by Reg.
